search_documents.name: search_documents
search_documents.description: Search across all ingested documents using full-text and semantic search. Returns matching text excerpts with document titles.

params.name: query
params.description: Search query text

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return

extract_entities.name: extract_entities
extract_entities.description: Extract or retrieve named entities (people, companies, shell entities, dates, money amounts, locations, designations) from a specific document.

params.name: document_id
params.description: ID of the document to extract entities from

find_contradictions.name: find_contradictions
find_contradictions.description: Compare two documents and find contradictions, conflicts, date mismatches, or inconsistencies between them.

params.name: doc_id_a
params.description: ID of the first document

params.name: doc_id_b
params.description: ID of the second document

build_timeline.name: build_timeline
build_timeline.description: Build a chronological timeline of all dated events found across specified documents.

params.name: document_ids
params.description: Comma-separated document IDs, or 'all' for entire corpus

query_entities.name: query_entities
query_entities.description: Find all appearances of a specific entity across the entire document corpus. Shows which documents mention this entity and in what context.

params.name: entity_name
params.description: Name of the entity to search for

params.name: entity_type
params.description: Type filter: person, company, shell_entity, date, money, location, designation. Leave empty for all types.

summarize_document.name: summarize_document
summarize_document.description: Generate a concise summary of a specific document, highlighting key findings, entities, and suspicious patterns.

params.name: document_id
params.description: ID of the document to summarize

get_document_stats.name: get_document_stats
get_document_stats.description: Get an overview of the current document corpus: total documents, total entities, entity type breakdown, most frequent entities, and recent additions.

list_entities_by_type.name: list_entities_by_type
list_entities_by_type.description: List all entities of a specific type across the entire corpus. Use this when asked 'who are all the people mentioned', 'list all companies', 'show all locations', etc. Groups by unique entity name and shows which documents each appears in.

params.name: entity_type
params.description: Entity type: person, company, shell_entity, date, money, location, designation, or 'all' for everything

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum entities to return, sorted by frequency

find_cross_document_entities.name: find_cross_document_entities
find_cross_document_entities.description: Find entities that appear across multiple documents — critical for cross-referencing investigations. Shows which entities connect different documents together. Use for questions like 'which entities appear in more than one document', 'show me every entity that appears in both the land records and ministry contracts'.

params.name: min_documents
params.description: Minimum number of documents an entity must appear in (default 2)

params.name: entity_type
params.description: Optional type filter: person, company, shell_entity, etc. Leave empty for all.

find_most_frequent_entities.name: find_most_frequent_entities
find_most_frequent_entities.description: Find the most frequently mentioned entities across the entire corpus, ranked by mention count. Use for questions like 'who are the three people who appear most frequently', 'what are the top companies mentioned'.

params.name: entity_type
params.description: Optional type filter: person, company, shell_entity, etc. Leave empty for all types.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of top entities to return

summarize_corpus.name: summarize_corpus
summarize_corpus.description: Summarize the ENTIRE investigation corpus — all documents combined into one narrative overview. Use when asked for 'a summary of the entire investigation', 'overview of all documents', 'what does this investigation show'.

deep_analysis.name: deep_analysis
deep_analysis.description: Perform deep analytical reasoning over the entire corpus with maximum context. Use for complex investigative questions: 'build a case for money laundering', 'who benefits most', 'what is the chain of money flow', 'if you were a journalist what would be your lead story', 'what questions should I ask in my next RTI', 'what are the next steps in this investigation'.

params.name: question
params.description: The analytical question to investigate

query_financial_data.name: query_financial_data
query_financial_data.description: Aggregate and analyze all financial/monetary data across the corpus or in a specific document. Use for: 'total money involved', 'summarize all financial transactions', 'how much FDI was received', 'declared value vs market value', 'was stamp duty correct', any question about amounts, payments, or values.

params.name: document_id
params.description: Optional: specific document ID. Leave empty to query entire corpus.

scan_for_red_flags.name: scan_for_red_flags
scan_for_red_flags.description: Systematically scan documents for suspicious patterns, illegal activity indicators, and red flags. Use for: 'any suspicious instructions', 'does this suggest illegal activity', 'anything unusual about this deal', 'what did the government refuse to provide', 'are there hidden patterns'.

params.name: document_id
params.description: Optional: specific document ID. Leave empty to scan entire corpus.

find_all_contradictions.name: find_all_contradictions
find_all_contradictions.description: Find ALL contradictions and inconsistencies across the entire document corpus, not just between two specific documents. Use for: 'any date contradictions across documents', 'find all inconsistencies', 'what conflicts exist between these documents'.

compare_events.name: compare_events
compare_events.description: Compare two events chronologically — which happened first, how far apart, and from which documents. Use for: 'which happened first, the payment or the signing', 'when was the land registered', 'did the approval come before or after the transaction'.

params.name: event_a
params.description: Description of the first event to find

params.name: event_b
params.description: Description of the second event to find

search_document_by_title.name: search_document_by_title
search_document_by_title.description: Find and retrieve a document by its title, description, or number rather than requiring an exact ID. Use for: 'what is Document 3 about', 'explain the RTI reply', 'the internal memo', 'the land registry document'. Returns the document text for analysis.

params.name: query
params.description: Document title, description, or number to search for

prompts.ocr_crossref:
You have TWO sources: the document IMAGE (above) and OCR text (below). The OCR may have errors, especially with non-Latin scripts (Hindi, Urdu, Arabic, etc.).

Cross-reference the image with the text. Correct any OCR errors by reading the image directly. Output the corrected full text.

If the document is in a non-English language:
1. First output the corrected text in the ORIGINAL language
2. Then output an English translation after a line '--- ENGLISH TRANSLATION ---'

OCR text (may contain errors):
{ocr_text}
prompts.ner_extract:
Extract all named entities from the following document text. Output ONLY valid JSON array.

[{"type":"person|company|shell_entity|date|money|location|designation","mention":"exact text as found","normalized":"cleaned lowercase form","start":0,"end":10,"metadata":{}}]

Entity type definitions:
- person: Individual names (politicians, executives, witnesses, etc.)
- company: Any company, firm, trust, organization, NGO
- shell_entity: Entities that appear to be intermediaries, holding companies, or PO boxes
- date: Any date or time reference (extract in YYYY-MM-DD format in metadata)
- money: Monetary amounts (include amount and currency in metadata)
- location: Places, addresses, districts, states, countries
- designation: Government titles, official positions, ranks

RULES:
- Extract ALL entities, even if repeated
- For money entities, include {"amount": number, "currency": "code"} in metadata
- For date entities, include {"iso_date": "YYYY-MM-DD"} in metadata
- If text is multilingual, extract entities in their original script AND transliterated form

Document text:
{text}
prompts.relationship_extract:
Given these entities found in a document, identify relationships between them.

Output JSON array:
[{"source":"entity normalized name","target":"entity normalized name","type":"mentioned_with|transacted_with|subsidiary_of|signed_by|appointed_by|located_at|paid_to|received_from","evidence":"supporting quote from text","confidence":0.0}]

Focus on:
- Financial transactions between entities
- Organizational hierarchies (subsidiary, parent company)
- People associated with companies or positions
- Geographic connections

Entities:
{entities}

Document text:
{text}
prompts.contradiction_check:
Compare these two document excerpts and identify ALL contradictions, conflicts, or inconsistencies.

Focus on:
- Date conflicts: same event appears with different dates
- Amount mismatches: same transaction shows different amounts
- Statement contradictions: conflicting claims about the same fact
- Entity discrepancies: same entity described differently or with different attributes
- Missing information: something present in one doc that should be in the other

Output JSON array:
[{"type":"date_conflict|amount_mismatch|statement_contradiction|entity_discrepancy","summary":"human-readable description","evidence_a":"exact quote from Document A","evidence_b":"exact quote from Document B","severity":"high|medium|low"}]

If no contradictions found, output an empty array: []

Document A ({doc_a_title}):
{text_a}

Document B ({doc_b_title}):
{text_b}
prompts.date_extract:
Extract all dates and time references from this text. Output JSON array:
[{"date":"YYYY-MM-DD","description":"what happened on this date","snippet":"exact surrounding text (max 200 chars)","type":"transaction|signing|audit|filing|meeting|registration|deadline|other"}]

RULES:
- Convert all date formats to ISO-8601 (YYYY-MM-DD)
- If only month/year is given, use first of month (YYYY-MM-01)
- If only year, use YYYY-01-01
- Include relative dates resolved to absolute if context allows
- For date ranges, create two entries (start and end)

Text:
{text}
prompts.combined_extract:
Analyze the following document and extract ALL of the following in a SINGLE JSON object.

Output ONLY valid JSON:
{
  "entities": [{"type":"person|company|shell_entity|date|money|location|designation","mention":"exact text","normalized":"cleaned lowercase","metadata":{}}],
  "relationships": [{"source":"entity normalized name","target":"entity normalized name","type":"mentioned_with|transacted_with|subsidiary_of|signed_by|appointed_by|located_at|paid_to|received_from","evidence":"supporting quote","confidence":0.8}],
  "dates": [{"date":"YYYY-MM-DD","description":"what happened","snippet":"surrounding text (max 200 chars)","type":"transaction|signing|audit|filing|meeting|other"}]
}

Entity types:
- person: Individual names
- company: Companies, firms, trusts, organizations
- shell_entity: Intermediaries, holding companies, PO boxes
- date: Date/time references (include iso_date in metadata)
- money: Monetary amounts (include amount and currency in metadata)
- location: Places, addresses, districts, states
- designation: Government titles, official positions

RULES:
- Extract ALL entities even if repeated
- For money: include {"amount": number, "currency": "code"} in metadata
- For dates: convert to YYYY-MM-DD format
- Relationships: identify financial, organizational, and geographic connections
- Be thorough — this is for investigative journalism

Document text:
{text}
prompts.summarize:
Summarize the following document concisely. Highlight:
1. Key entities mentioned (people, companies, amounts)
2. Important dates and events
3. Any suspicious patterns or red flags
4. The document's apparent purpose

Keep the summary under 300 words.

Document title: {title}
Document text:
{text}
prompts.translate:
Translate the following text from {source_lang} to {target_lang}. Preserve:
- Proper nouns (names, places, organizations) — keep original + translation
- Numbers and dates exactly as they appear
- Document formatting and structure

Text:
{text}
